Reserved pubkey constants and lookup functions for active, pending, and secp256r1 keys.

# Purpose
This C file defines a set of constant `fd_pubkey_t` values for well known Solana system accounts and program IDs. It includes IDs for sysvars, core programs, SPL items, loader programs, and related buffer or authority addresses. These constants give the rest of the code base a single source of truth for fixed public keys used by the runtime and by account checks.

The file also builds two perfect hash tables, `fd_pubkey_active_reserved_keys_tbl` and `fd_pubkey_pending_reserved_keys_tbl`, from a template in `fd_map_perfect.c`. These tables provide fast lookup functions for reserved account keys, and the file exposes small helper APIs: [`fd_pubkey_is_active_reserved_key`](<#fd_pubkey_is_active_reserved_key>), [`fd_pubkey_is_pending_reserved_key`](<#fd_pubkey_is_pending_reserved_key>), and [`fd_pubkey_is_secp256r1_key`](<#fd_pubkey_is_secp256r1_key>). The last function checks whether a public key matches the `fd_solana_secp256r1_program_id` value by comparing the 32-byte key data.
